caption: This shoyu ramen features a rich, dark broth with tender noodles, topped with halved soft-boiled egg and crisp menma. Fresh green onions crown the bowl, served in a patterned ceramic bowl against a vibrant red background under bright, even lighting.

segments_info.text: The table is a smooth, solid red surface with subtle light reflections and faint texture variations.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and rich, with visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with fibrous texture and irregular curved shape.
A halved boiled egg shows a vibrant orange-red yolk with a glossy, slightly runny texture, encased in a firm white shell.
White ceramic bowl with red rim and green dragon motifs, smooth glossy surface, circular shape with decorative pattern.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved bowl shape.
